document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your party chances upon a cave deep enough to shelter you 
from the smoke and heat on the surface. For over a day, the fire 
traps you underground.

When  you  finally  emerge,  you  see  a  charred,  devastated 
landscape. The probable damage to the valley’s unique flora and 
fauna sickens you. Over a carpet of smoldering embers and ash, 
through endless stands of whitened spikes and blackened logs, 
you make your way to the fissure by which you now leave the 
lost land.
